code:
docker run -d -p 3000:8080 --add-host=host.docker.internal:host-gateway \
  -v open-webui:/app/backend/data --name open-webui --restart always \
  ghcr.io/open-webui/open-webui:main
description: The Docker route for OpenWebUI, with each flag doing one job: publishing a port, reaching Ollama on the host, and keeping your data in a named volume.

steps.description: This runs OpenWebUI in Docker. The page says OpenWebUI is a self-hosted web front end that sits in front of your Ollama server. There are two ways to install it, and Docker is the recommended one if Docker Desktop is already running.

`-p 3000:8080` publishes the container's port 8080 on your host's port 3000. `--add-host=host.docker.internal:host-gateway` lets the container reach Ollama on your host, required on Linux and harmless elsewhere. `-d` runs it in the background.

`-v open-webui:/app/backend/data` keeps your account, models, and chat history in a named volume that survives restarts. `--name open-webui` names the container, and `--restart always` keeps it running.

title: Running OpenWebUI in Docker
